The structure of Tl6Al2Ag2 crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with a 36-atom unit cell and three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Al and Ag each adopt tetrahedral coordination with eight Tl neighbors, while Tl has ten geometric neighbors (six Al, two Ag, two Tl). The periodic neighbor graph is fully connected in three dimensions. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner- and edge-sharing between Al and Ag tetrahedra, and corner-sharing between Al and Tl polyhedra.
